sections.content:
The cursor moved from col 15 to col 22 after 4 LEFT presses. So each LEFT moves the cursor by 7 columns (15 → 22). The 5 symbol positions are at cols 15, 22, 29, 36, 43. So LEFT cycles through positions 0→1→2→3→4→0... and RIGHT goes the other direction.
Now cursor is at col 22 (position 1). I wasted 4 LEFT actions to discover this. Let me now systematically explore what UP does at each position to understand the symbol cycling, then figure out the matching goal.
But first, I need to be more efficient. Let me record the current state of all bottom symbols, then try UP at this position to see what changes.

sections.label: TOOL CALL: python
sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# Record current bottom symbol hashes
seg = current_frame.segmentation
nodes = seg['nodes']

bottom_black = []
for n in nodes:
    if n['color'] == 'B':
        min_row = min(p[0] for p in n['boundary'])
        if 40 <= min_row <= 57:
            bottom_black.append(n)

bottom_black.sort(key=lambda n: (min(p[0] for p in n['boundary']), min(p[1] for p in n['boundary'])))

print("Current bottom symbol hashes:")
for i, n in enumerate(bottom_black):
    min_row = min(p[0] for p in n['boundary'])
    row = "blue" if min_row < 50 else "pink"
    print(f"  {row} symbol {i}: hash={n['hash']}, pixels={n['pixels']}")

# Now try UP to see what changes at position 1 (col 22)
action(['UP'])

# Check what changed
seg2 = current_frame.segmentation
nodes2 = seg2['nodes']
bottom_black2 = []
for n in nodes2:
    if n['color'] == 'B':
        min_row = min(p[0] for p in n['boundary'])
        if 40 <= min_row <= 57:
            bottom_black2.append(n)
bottom_black2.sort(key=lambda n: (min(p[0] for p in n['boundary']), min(p[1] for p in n['boundary'])))

print("\nAfter UP at position 1:")
for i, n in enumerate(bottom_black2):
    min_row = min(p[0] for p in n['boundary'])
    row = "blue" if min_row < 50 else "pink"
    print(f"  {row} symbol {i}: hash={n['hash']}, pixels={n['pixels']}")

# Find which symbols changed
print("\nChanged symbols:")
for i in range(len(bottom_black)):
    if bottom_black[i]['hash'] != bottom_black2[i]['hash']:
        min_row = min(p[0] for p in bottom_black[i]['boundary'])
        row = "blue" if min_row < 50 else "pink"
        print(f"  {row} symbol {i}: {bottom_black[i]['hash']} -> {bottom_black2[i]['hash']}")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
